S.FORM: == babaledaw == 擬稻蝗/ sa lebulebud ku babaledaw i umaumahan. siwkay nu babaledaw u kulit nu babaledaw a kidu sa, u landaway atu makulahay . sapilimet i liwliw , u midiputay a kulit 保護色. mukan tu nipaluma' ku babaledaw, sisa mabidang ku malukay tu babaledaw. itawya, tuduhen ikiken nu malukay ku babaledaw, bangsis a'su tu. hali mukan tu niyazu'ay a tademaw. mibabaledaw 抓蝗蟲/ mibabaledaw kaku i umaumahan nacila. sibabaledawan 有蝗蟲的地方/ sibabaledaw ku umah ni Kacaw. u sulit nu Amilika Locusts are certain species of short-horned grasshoppers in the family Acrididae that have a swarming phase. These insects are usually solitary, but under certain circumstances, become more abundant and change their behaviour and habits, becoming gregarious. No taxonomic distinction is made between locust and grasshopper species; the basis for the definition is whether a species forms swarms under intermittently suitable conditions.
S.PHON: == babar~ɾədaw == ***/ sa r~ɾəbur~ɾəbud ku babar~ɾədaw i umaumaħan. siwkaj nu babar~ɾədaw u kur~ɾit nu babar~ɾədaw a kidu sa, u r~ɾandawaj atu makur~ɾaħaj . sapir~ɾimət i r~ɾiwr~ɾiw , u midiputaj a kur~ɾit ***. mukan tu nipar~ɾumaʔ~ʡ ku babar~ɾədaw, sisa mabidaŋ ku mar~ɾukaj tu babar~ɾədaw. itawja, tuduħən ikikən nu mar~ɾukaj ku babar~ɾədaw, baŋsis aʔ~ʡsu tu. ħar~ɾi mukan tu nijazuʔ~ʡaj a tadəmaw. mibabar~ɾədaw ***/ mibabar~ɾədaw kaku i umaumaħan naʦir~ɾa. sibabar~ɾədawan ******/ sibabar~ɾədaw ku umaħ ni kaʦaw. u sur~ɾit nu amir~ɾika r~ɾoʦusts arə ʦərtain spəʦiəs of sħort-ħornəd grassħoppərs in tħə famir~ɾj aʦrididaə tħat ħa*ə a swarmiŋ pħasə. tħəsə insəʦts arə usuar~ɾr~ɾj sor~ɾitarj, but undər ʦərtain ʦirʦumstanʦəs, bəʦomə morə abundant and ʦħaŋə tħəir bəħa*iour and ħabits, bəʦomiŋ grəgarious. no ta*onomiʦ distinʦtion is madə bətwəən r~ɾoʦust and grassħoppər spəʦiəs; tħə basis for tħə dəfinition is wħətħər a spəʦiəs forms swarms undər intərmittəntr~ɾj suitabr~ɾə ʦonditions.
